title: crdm-detect, evaluated over its adjudicated issue corpus
description: Dogfood test plan #1 (bean folio-assistant-ff09, arc 3fva). One case per issue of the whole 27-issue corpus. Each case REQUIRES that the detector classify the issue and INFORMS whether the classification matches the adjudicated label; so the report's precision, recall and F1 are recorded and no number gates the decision (owner, 2026-10-11, option 4: the certification certifies that the plan was executed). Exit criteria are the platform default: completed, hashed, every case accounted for, the untainted checker agrees, no required assertion failed, something passed.

testCases.description: Issue #243 “write code policy for humans/agents” — adjudicated label: not a feature request.

assertions.expectation: the detector returns a classification (fires or not, with its categories) for the issue text
the classification agrees with the adjudicated label (does not fire) — recorded, never gating (owner, 2026-10-11: no threshold)
